The number 0 u0 cosu is called the scalar component of u in the direction of v (or of u onto v). To summarize,
The vector projection of u onto v is the vector
projv u = au # v
The scalar component of u in the direction of v is the scalar
0 u0 cosu = u # v 0 v0 = u # v

Note that both the vector projection of u onto v and the scalar component of u onto v depend only on the direction of the vector v and not its length (because we dot u with v> 0 v0 , which is the direction of v).
